description: Kasteel Rechteren stands in a moat east of Dalfsen. A round brick tower carries an octagonal pear-shaped slate spire beside 1726 entrance wings under mansard roofs. The castle is not open. It is partly cloudy, about 8.8°C, with wind near 4.0 km/h and cloud cover about 62%. The 1890s neo-Gothic work was removed and is not shown. No coat of arms is readable.
